passages.s: Hence to fight and conquer in all your battles is not supreme excellence; supreme excellence consists in breaking the enemy’s resistance without fighting.
Regard your soldiers as your children, and they will follow you into the deepest valleys; look on them as your own beloved sons, and they will stand by you even unto death.
If soldiers are punished before they have grown attached to you, they will not prove submissive; and, unless submissive, then will be practically useless.

*.fr: l'excellence suprême n'est pas de vaincre en toutes batailles, mais de briser la résistance sans combattre
*.en: supreme excellence is not conquering in every battle, but breaking resistance without fighting

anchors.startsWith: Hence to fight and conquer in all your battles is not supreme excellence; supreme excellence consists in breaking the enemy’s resistance without fighting.

*.fr: tiens tes soldats comme tes enfants : ils te suivront jusqu'au bout
*.en: hold your soldiers as your children: they will follow you to the end

anchors.startsWith: Regard your soldiers as your children, and they will follow you into the deepest valleys; look on them as your own beloved sons, and they will stand by you even unto death.

*.fr: la discipline sans attachement ne fait que des instruments inutiles
*.en: discipline without attachment makes only useless instruments

anchors.startsWith: If soldiers are punished before they have grown attached to you, they will not prove submissive; and, unless submissive, then will be practically useless.

*.fr: interdis les présages : la victoire se calcule et se renseigne, elle ne se devine pas
*.en: ban omens: victory is calculated and informed, never divined

anchors.startsWith: Prohibit the taking of omens, and do away with superstitious doubts.

*.fr: comme l'eau, l'armée épouse le terrain : la victoire suit les circonstances
*.en: like water, an army takes the shape of the ground: victory follows circumstance

anchors.startsWith: Water shapes its course according to the nature of the ground over which it flows; the soldier works out his victory in relation to the foe whom he is facing.

*.fr: la durée épuise : aucun pays n'a profité d'une guerre prolongée
*.en: duration exhausts: no country has profited from prolonged warfare
